items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: it sounded like Wagner, you know

ctx.x: Well I’m not sure how much I should trust all this but what about playing for Big Bird?

Yeah you know it’s funny you say that because I went to school, I took some college in Washington DC, my hometown, and Jerry Nelson was in the same class, and he was Big Bird. He ended up being Big Bird. So, small world you know. And he also lived in my neighborhood in New York. I ran into him. But I don’t remember the music. I remember one thing on the Muppet Movie, the arranger — eh, 88 years old, my memory — but Kermit the Frog was doing a jazz waltz and the bass player, the electric bass player had just…
I always wanted to work on the Muppet show, I thought that was just brilliant throughout.
